The Defective Detective - Album 2: Serah Investigates

Don’t Mess with Nessa

"Don’t mess with Nessa She remembers every part"

[Verse] Coda leads us down a crooked lane Stops outside a steel-plated frame Three locks Four wires One blinking eye Workshop hidden where the bright minds hide

She leans in close to the intercom “Hey, Nessa, it’s me. Open up.” Static pops, then a sharpened tone

“No.”

Kamira snorts Serah blinks Andy looks between us all Coda mutters, “That seems excessive.”

The speaker cracks:

“You broke seventy-four of the seventy-eight things I made for you.”

[Pre-Chorus] Coda says, “In my defense—”

“No defense.”

“Innovation requires—”

“Go away.”

[Chorus] Don’t mess with Nessa She remembers every part Every tool you never brought back Every fire Every spark

Don’t mess with Nessa Pink hair Green eyes Mind like glass Sharp as light

If you waste her work Or test her patience

Good luck getting past

[Verse] Serah steps up, calm and clean “Private investigator. Need five minutes, maybe three.” Silence answers Nothing clicks

Kamira tries with journalist charm “I love your work—” No change in form

Then Andy lifts his little hand Looks at the door Like doors are just doors

“Hi.”

“My name is Andy.”

“I need your help.”

[Pre-Chorus] Three dead bolts One soft whir Then suddenly the whole thing stirs

Coda folds her arms and sighs “Okay, that’s a little embarrassing.”

[Chorus] Don’t mess with Nessa But maybe ask her nice Past the gate and through the threshold Everything ignites

Don’t mess with Nessa Blueprint walls and sleepless nights Half-built wonders Copper circuits Ancient code and modern light

[Verse] Workshop glowing wall to wall Drafting tables, parts and scrolls Engines humming Lenses bright Ink-stained pages stacked in piles

One machine sits near the back Spinning symbols over glass Coda stops, “What is that?”

Nessa doesn’t even look up

“Something you cannot borrow.”

Kamira grins, “I like her already.”

[Pre-Chorus] Forbidden scroll Sealed text Old language tangled into hex Codes inside the code itself

Even Coda couldn’t crack the rest

[Chorus] Don’t mess with Nessa She decodes what others hide Builds a key from scraps and theories Makes dead languages come alive

Don’t mess with Nessa Every question multiplies If the Company says “forbidden” That’s exactly what she’ll try

[Bridge] Serah lays the photos down Anna Arty Van route Town

“We’re looking for his family.”

Nessa’s fingers finally still

Then she says it Flat and simple Like the name should mean enough

“Lyra’s back.”

Serah turns so fast it hurts

“Lyra?”

“As in Lyra?”

Nessa nods. “Yes. You should ask her.”

Coda frowns, “Who’s Lyra?”

Kamira glances sideways Serah doesn’t blink

“Nobody good for my blood pressure.”

[Break] Coda asked “You know her?”

Nessa says “She’s new.”

“I’ve been gone a while.”

“Almost a year.”

Andy asked “Can she help us find Mom?”

Silence

Then Nessa stands

[Pre-Chorus] Coat on chair Tools aside One long look Then her reply

“If Andy’s family crossed her path…”

“You won’t get far alone tonight.”

[Chorus] Don’t mess with Nessa She has standards She has spite She has seventy-four good reasons Not to trust Coda on sight

Don’t mess with Nessa But once the problem feels real enough She’ll leave the workshop Take the question And decide to call the bluff

[Final Chorus] Don’t mess with Nessa Now the room has changed again Fox Kid Goblin Hakujya And an elf with too much sense

Don’t mess with Nessa If Lyra’s really back in play Then every road we’ve walked so far Just found another gate

Don’t mess with Nessa Not the mind Not the scroll Not the fire in what she makes

And if she says she’s coming with us

Then nobody hesitates

[Outro] Nessa kills the decoder light Sweeps the blueprints to one side Takes one bag Checks one tool Locks the bench and shuts the file

Serah watches Still not settled

“Wait…”

“You know Lyra?”

Nessa opens the door wider

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“Yes.”

“And if she’s moving again…”

“We should leave now.”
